scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @firebridge/api && npm run build --workspace @firebridge/worker
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @firebridge/api -- --run && npm run test --workspace @firebridge/worker -- --run
scripts.pretest: npm run build --workspace @firebridge/contracts && npm run build --workspace @firebridge/database && npm run build --workspace @firebridge/results
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/results/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
